title: 第23章 紫阳九重关第24章 服从性测试
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 秘境对团体修士的识别较为宽松，只要间隔不超过数米，便都可算作一个团体，也有许多散修借着这个机制跟在一些团体之后进入，但难说这是明智之举。
和以往几次进入秘境一样，随着眼前的白雾散去，陈昭便觉着自己已经来到了秘境之中，只是时过境迁，周围不再是将自己当狗看的天门宗修士，而是同队的五个散修。
也许是因为进入的修士太多，又或是才是刚进入的阶段，陈昭一眼望去，周围百米散落着许多修士团体，显然是都被秘境传送到了同一片区域之中。
倒是没见有筑基修士的存在，看来是被秘境传送到别处了。
好浓郁的灵气！”
缓过神来的白琪惊喜道。
不光是白琪，许多修士都惊奇的称赞秘境灵气的浓郁，有些队伍里的修士更是激动的直接原地坐下开始修炼起来。
“嗯，很浓郁的灵气，不愧是秘境啊”
陈昭迎合道，心中却不断在和另一方秘境比较。
这紫阳秘境的灵气也许比起玄清界来说是浓郁不少，但和那宝石秘境相比，真是差的不止一星半点儿了。
可以说是远远不如宝石秘境了。
“灵气如此浓郁，看来这回秘境之中的资源定不会少，道友们，尽快前进吧”
“张道友说的对，那些个天材地宝是先到先得，若是沉迷于灵气浓郁在此修炼，被他人夺了先，那便是舍本逐末了。”
虽然这话由一个魔修说出来，难免有几分催促猎物进陷阱的感觉，但大体上说的确实没错，队伍其他人也都表示赞同，一齐前进起来。
众人向前进了一会，便见前方有一栋巨大的石碑，其上刻着几排大字，都是关于秘境的内容。
“张道友，这其上写的都是啥，俺是个粗人，不咋识字嘞。”
“金道友莫急，容我看上一会。”
魔修张寺倒是没当场应下，而是先细细看了一遍，确信读出来并无大碍后，才开始念诵。
“紫阳天，紫阳开，正果须渡九重关。”
“一关厚黎庶，二关绝外物”
“三关正本源，四关去红尘”
“五关需辟谷，六关破虚妄”
“七关齐身心，八关勤辛劳”
“九关虽破勿忘本，千金散去还复来”
“诸位道友，看来想要获得这紫阳秘境的传承，需要我们闯过九关啊”
众人点点头，均思索起来。
这几排大字看起来简单易懂，不知有何深意。
虽然修士记忆良好，但陈昭隐隐感觉还是抄上更好，从储物袋中拿出一副纸笔，迅速的将这几行字抄写下来。
其他修士见状也有样学样，记录下了石碑的内容。
content_en:
The secret realm's identification of group monks is relatively loose. As long as the distance is no more than a few meters, they can be counted as a group. There are also many casual cultivators who follow some groups and enter through this mechanism, but it is difficult to say that this is a wise move.
Just like the previous times when he entered the secret realm, as the white mist in front of him dissipated, Chen Zhao felt that he had arrived in the secret realm. However, time passed and he was no longer surrounded by Tianmen Sect monks who treated him like a dog, but by five casual cultivators from the same team.
Maybe it was because there were too many monks entering, or maybe it was just entering the stage. Chen Zhao took a quick look and saw many groups of monks scattered about a hundred meters around. Apparently, they were all transported to the same area by the secret realm.
However, no foundation-building monks were seen. It seemed that they had been teleported elsewhere by the secret realm.
"Wow!
What a rich aura! "
Bai Qi, who had regained consciousness, said in surprise.
Not only Bai Qi, many monks were surprised to praise the richness of the spiritual energy in the secret realm. Some monks in the team were so excited that they sat down and started practicing.
"Well, it's a very rich spiritual energy. It's worthy of being in a secret realm."
Chen Zhaoying said, but he kept comparing it with the other secret realm in his heart.
The aura of the Ziyang Secret Realm may be much richer than that of the Xuanqing Realm, but compared with the Gemstone Secret Realm, it is really not even close to a star.
It can be said that it is far inferior to the Gem Secret Realm.
"The spiritual energy is so strong, it seems that there will be no shortage of resources in the secret realm this time. Fellow Taoists, please move forward as soon as possible."
"Fellow Daoist Zhang is right. Those heavenly and earthly treasures are on a first-come, first-served basis. If you are addicted to practicing here with rich spiritual energy and are overtaken by others, you will be giving up the basics to the last."
Although these words were spoken by a demon cultivator, it inevitably felt like urging prey into a trap, but in general it was indeed correct, and the rest of the team also agreed and moved forward together.
After everyone moved forward for a while, they saw a huge stone monument in front of them, with several rows of large characters engraved on it, all about the secret realm.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, what's written on it? I'm a rough guy and I don't know how to read."
"Fellow Daoist Jin, don't be impatient. Let me take a look at it for a while."
Mo Xiuzhangsi did not agree on the spot, but read it carefully first, and only started to recite it after he was sure that it was not harmful to read.
"Purple Sun Heaven, the Purple Sun opens, and the true fruit must pass through the nine levels."
"The first barrier protects the common people, the second barrier protects against foreign objects."
"Three passes to get to the origin, four passes to get rid of the world of mortals"
"The five levels require fasting the grain, and the six levels eliminate illusions."
"Seven passes to harmonize the body and mind, eight passes to work hard"
"Although the nine passes are broken, don't forget the roots. Even if a thousand pieces of gold are scattered, you will come back again."
"Fellow Taoists, it seems that if we want to obtain the inheritance of the Ziyang Secret Realm, we need to pass nine levels."
Everyone nodded and started thinking.
These rows of big characters look simple and easy to understand, but I don’t know what they mean.
Although the monk had a good memory, Chen Zhao vaguely felt that it would be better to copy it. He took out a pen and paper from his storage bag and quickly copied these lines.
When other monks saw this, they followed suit and recorded the contents of the stone tablet.
